title: Remote foundations M1c: a supported operator surface to configure a host as a SATELLITE of a named central (role satellite + central identity), required before Mac enrollment
outcome: Remote foundations M1c: a supported operator surface to configure a host as a SATELLITE of a named central (role satellite + central identity), required before Mac enrollment
acceptance: A supported operator surface (the M1b settings route or an equally supported one) configures this host as role 'satellite' bound to a named central host identity (host_id/generation from that central), validated, version- and content-fenced, and persisted durably; today the settings route rejects Satellite

disable holds federation admission with the central binding retained; a separate request returns the host to standalone; in each state local sessions and mailboxes without a domain binding behave unchanged; a mismatched or stale central identity is refused with a typed error
The read surface shows role satellite, the bound central identity and link state, so an operator can verify it before running the O1 verification checklist
Exact-input focused tests, the full five-stage gate and an independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding

completion.summary: M1c landed as d520f6f1 on master, a fast-forward from 89211511. Opus2 pushed it and verified it with ls-remote. The federation settings route configures this host as a satellite bound to a named central's exact identity, fenced on the version the operator read, with the content fence confirmed through the state writer, and durable. Typed refusals carry a stable code beside the error: expected version required, version conflict, invalid binding, stale central, mismatched central, bound sessions. Disable keeps the binding and holds admission; standalone is a separate request; unbound local sessions and mailboxes are unchanged. GET /api/federation adds the version and a satellite block (central, centralPeer link state and generations, boundSessions) for the pre-O1 check. Evidence: focused GREEN test-e7ebea37 49/49; full gate test-d061ab2d 5/5; review pair r2 clean (the r1 High fixed and reviewed again); the carry onto 89211511 audited; independent evaluation 0f14220408db493fa7ff6f4912dc6513 passed 4/4. Follow-ups filed: w-4225e10f6f80 (unbind workflow), w-677dcabf6f49 and w-2dce32b82d49 (r2 Lows).
